title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Elena Park
description:
Motivation: provide ready-to-use RAG templates and agent/tool-calling examples to accelerate developer onboarding and real-world quickstarts. This PR adds opinionated RAG template YAMLs, a set of agent playbook examples (Python and TypeScript), a small tool-calling playground for the examples repo, and updates to the docs site quickstarts and sidebars so the content is discoverable.

Changes include: templates for basic RAG, two-phase retrieval, and streaming agents; sample tool adapters (search, knowledge base, web-fetch) used by examples; runnable quickstarts demonstrating tool-calling and structured output; docs site navigation and a small CI tweak to build docs on PRs.

Notes: examples are intentionally small (single-file agents) and reference the Redwood SDK. Secrets/credentials in examples are stubbed and callouts are present in the docs to avoid accidental copy-paste of real credentials. Linear: ENG-1428 (RAG quickstarts), ENG-1499 (agent templates).
